author: /root/cycle8_native_catalog
implementation: Schema v22 adds immutable provider_catalog_snapshots with provider scope, content hash, bounded sanitized models JSON, timestamp and append-only triggers.
provider_models_list persists successful sanitized discovery idempotently and returns deterministic snapshotId plus snapshotSha256.
Prepared provider lineage binds the newest persisted snapshot that explicitly contains the selected model; unknown models remain unbound and dispatch remains fail-closed.
Migration split boundaries prevent v20/v21 upgrade paths from installing v22 objects before the v22 migration.

negativeCases: Hash mismatch is rejected before insertion.
Identical snapshot content is idempotent and does not duplicate rows.
Existing snapshot rows are immutable via SQLite triggers.
No matching model leaves lineage catalog fields unset rather than inventing a route.
claimBoundary: This receipt now proves source, formatting and the two focused native test suites. Packaged desktop IPC, live provider refresh, failed-refresh preservation, running-attempt snapshot retention and disappeared-model reporting remain unproven; ADVSET-003 must remain Partial until those runtime boundaries have direct evidence.
